component.name: Aether
component.summary: Native Material 3 download manager without a WebView

description.p: Aether is a desktop download manager with a native Rust and Slint interface: no embedded browser, no Electron.

A background daemon supervises per-protocol plugins for HTTP(S), BitTorrent, HLS and DASH streaming, FTP, WebDAV, S3 and cloud drives. It supports resumable transfers, a priority queue with scheduled download windows, desktop notifications, a browser-extension handoff, and signed automatic updates.
